description: Ministry of Sports and Youth Affairs - National Associations of Sports Registrations No 01 of 2024
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs under the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973. It establishes new regulatory requirements for the registration and operation of National Sports Associations/Federations, including detailed procedures, documentation requirements, and classification criteria. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it creates new regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements rather than focusing on government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
